title: SG-11.2 BootScene listens for transitionTo and fades to the requested scene
summary: BootScene subscribes to transitionTo, fades the camera out and starts the requested scene, and unsubscribes on shutdown
description: Context: events.ts already declares ReactToPhaserEvents.transitionTo { sceneId } and BootScene already listens for playAnimation, but nothing consumes transitionTo. Desired behavior: BootScene.create subscribes to transitionTo, runs a camera fade-out and then starts the requested scene, and releases the subscription in its SHUTDOWN handler. Expected result: React can drive scene changes through the typed bus. Why: SG-11 drives animations and transitions from game actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create ran, when transitionTo { sceneId } is emitted, then the main camera fades out
Given the fade-out completes, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with the requested sceneId
Given the SHUTDOWN callback ran, when transitionTo is emitted, then no fade or scene start occurs
technical_constraints: Use the existing reactToPhaser bus from frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
definition_of_done: Both requirements have Act and Verify units complete
Unit tests pass with Phaser mocked
